sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Full-bleed portrait 4:5 hand-painted oil/gouache game puzzle background with rich natural textures, believable perspective and calm inviting detail. FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting: every pixel opaque, alpha255 everywhere, including edges; no transparency or black voids. Not a photo, vector, UI, collage or diagram. No text, digits, logos, famous landmarks or border. A complete coherent environment; leave only specified tiny later details absent and paint their natural anchor surfaces. Wide intimate view from slightly above of a rustic harvest-fair stall made of COCOA BROWN timber, deep brown boards and woven baskets dominating frame, tasteful orange pumpkins painted with simple leaf motifs, dried corn, autumn berries, folded cloth, little lanterns, no people or words. Reserve one visible empty brass hook on stall upright for a small lantern, one thin bare stem on front small pumpkin for a leaf, one plain knotted parcel on counter for a ribbon bow, one short bare twig in a little pottery vase for autumn foliage, and one empty horizontal twine segment under roof for a small pennant. Complete dark warm brown scene, no lettering.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production painted game cutout atlas, landscape1536x1024, genuine transparent RGBA. Invisible3x2 grid, five complete tiny objects in reading order, sixth lower-right empty. Whole objects within central280x300 of each512x512 cell with100px transparent gutters. No border, text, labels, drawn grid, backdrop or glow. Warm detailed oil/gouache brush texture, natural upper-left lighting. For a cocoa-brown autumn harvest stall: (1) a tiny antique bronze lantern with complete closed top ring and amber candle light confined inside glass, no long cord; (2) one small fresh pumpkin leaf with thin bare cut stem, no roots; (3) a little brown acorn lying flat viewed three-quarter from above with a tight soft transparent contact shadow, no table; (4) a fine twig of russet oak leaves with bare lower cut stem; (5) one small muted ochre linen pennant with two complete tiny loops along its straight upper edge. Warm dusk crafts detail.
